questions.question: In your electrical design engineer role developing intelligent down-hole oil drilling tools, describe a project where you designed or integrated electrical hardware from requirements through testing. What were your specific responsibilities and results?
What experience do you have designing power distribution, motor control circuits, or electrical wiring for industrial equipment or facilities?
Describe an automated test system you developed using LabVIEW and Python. How did you define the test requirements, interface with the hardware, and validate the system’s accuracy and reliability?
Your CV mentions automating calibration for accelerometers and magnetometers. How did you establish the calibration procedure, manage measurement uncertainty, and document the results?
This role involves PLC control systems and control panels. What exposure have you had to PLCs, industrial control architectures, I/O design, or control-panel development?
How would you approach developing electrical schematics and control logic for a water or wastewater pumping or treatment system, including motors, instruments, alarms, and automated sequences?
What is your familiarity with the National Electrical Code, and how have you applied electrical safety, grounding, overcurrent protection, or wiring requirements in prior work?

Describe your experience using CAD tools, including any work with electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, layouts, or design-document revisions. Which tools did you use and what deliverables did you create?
Give an example of a technical issue discovered during hardware testing or integration. How did you diagnose the root cause, coordinate a solution, and verify the corrective action?

This position includes reviewing construction documents, shop drawings, and supporting startup activities. How would you review an electrical submittal or prepare for commissioning and field testing of a new control system?
